datasets.name: PlanetScope L3B images
datasets.verbatim: PlanetScope images are low cost and can be freely obtained from the Education and Research Program offered by Planet Laboratories.

methods.name: Change detection-based region-based level set evolution (RLSE)
methods.summary: A semiautomated method that combines change detection (using ICA, PCA, or CVA) to generate initial zero-level curves (ZLCs) with a region-based level set evolution (RLSE) process to refine the landslide boundaries.
methods.source: Ping Lu, Wenyang Shi, and Zhongbin Li
methods.verbatim: In this study, through the improvement of change detection-based RLSE [28], we develop a novel landslide mapping approach, in which CDIs were generated from ICA and PCA instead of CVA.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the RLSE method lacks a repository or persistent link.
